# InboundOnSteroids

> LinkedIn content and outreach for agency founders, built and run by Ivan Manfredi. The full service starts at $3,000 a month, and each extra team account adds $1,000 a month. Outreach goes out from the client's own LinkedIn account and replies are handled through to a booked call.

## Services

- [AI outreach systems for agencies](https://inboundonsteroids.com/ai-outbound-systems-for-agencies/): who builds them, how the system works step by step, pricing and booked-call results
- [LinkedIn outreach services](https://inboundonsteroids.com/linkedin-outreach-services/): buyer research, messages and conversations
- [LinkedIn inbound lead generation](https://inboundonsteroids.com/linkedin-inbound-lead-generation/): posts, lead magnets and resources

## Articles

- [LinkedIn outreach pricing in 2026: what a LinkedIn lead generation agency costs](https://inboundonsteroids.com/blog/linkedin-outreach-agency-pricing/): published prices from Cleverly, LeadCookie, Pearl Lemon Leads, ROI Maximizer and others, read on 12 November 2026, the ways agencies charge and the arithmetic for cost per booked call
